visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of wooden shelves filled with glass jars containing different types of miso paste. Each jar has a white label and a metal lid. Bright text overlays appear in the center. (2) A transition zooms out to reveal a close-up of a wooden tray holding a bowl of miso soup and a wrapped rice ball onigiri. (3) A hand points towards a white sign or truck exterior with Japanese text and logos. (4) The camera returns to the interior shop view, panning across the colorful miso paste jars on the wooden shelves. (5) A hand holds a printed menu listing numbers and regional miso flavors from 47 Japanese prefectures. (6) A female customer wearing a beige trench coat is served a bowl of soup at a small wooden table inside the shop. (7) Close-up shots show the woman using wooden chopsticks to stir the soup and then sipping it from the wooden bowl. (8) Macro shots highlight the soup's ingredients, including green seaweed and cubes of tofu. (9) A close-up of another bowl showing a much darker, richer miso broth. (10) A hand holds an onigiri that has been bitten into, showing the filling. (11) A wide shot shows the shop's counter, product display cases, and warm wooden interior design. (12) Closing graphics show social media icons and website information.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specialty miso soup shop named 'Miso Mebore' in Roppongi, Tokyo. It highlights the unique selling point of offering 47 varieties of regional miso from all over Japan, showing the selection process and a positive tasting experience to attract food lovers.
